summary.text: Jonathan Kyle is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates for District 66, which he has represented since December 2024, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He is a real estate investor.

paragraphs.text: Jonathan Kyle was born in Elkins, West Virginia, and earned a bachelor's degree in accounting from Marshall University.
His career experience includes working as a real estate investor.
Kyle took office in the House of Delegates on December 1, 2024, succeeding Republican William Nestor, and advanced from the Republican primary on May 12, 2026.
